## Summary of the last run

The page is a careful treatment of quotient rings. I checked the theorem statements, proofs, hypchecks, examples, and the supplement. The hypcheck counterexamples (Z ⊂ Q as additive subgroup not ideal; noncommutative case; coprime vs. total sum) are all correct. The CRT counterexamples are correct. The Gaussian integer examples and the Z[i]/(3) problem are correct. The supplement's coequalizer description is informal but essentially accurate (the coequalizer of the two maps from a polynomial ring sending x_a to a and to 0 is A/I). I found no genuine logical, hypothesis, or factual errors worth reporting.
